subject: Taxes
title: The Taxpayer Advocate
description: A 60-second lesson on The Taxpayer Advocate.

hook.text: The IRS has a built-in critic: the Taxpayer Advocate Service.

buildup.text: Created by Congress in 1996, the Advocate is independent within the IRS.

discovery.text: The Advocate handles over 200,000 cases per year—people locked out of refunds, wrongly assessed penalties.

twist.text: Recent Advocates criticized the IRS for disproportionately auditing low-income earners while ignoring wealthy cheats.

climax.text: The Taxpayer Advocate proves that even a powerful agency needs internal checks.

punchline.text: The IRS's own critic, funded by the IRS. Internal accountability in action.

quiz.question: What does the Taxpayer Advocate Service do?
options: Helps taxpayers resolve IRS problems and publicly criticizes IRS failures
